//: The approved sha256 digest for every image this deployment pins. This is the single source of truth for what is APPROVED, separate from docker-compose.yml (what is actually RUNNING) - installation-scripts/validate-config.sh fails if the two disagree, and installation-scripts/check-digest-drift.sh fails if this disagrees with what the registry currently serves for the same tag. Update this file only when cutting a release (documentation/39-release-procedure.md) or after deliberately auditing drift reported by check-digest-drift.sh. Never hardcode a digest in a script - read this file instead.

dmss-container-and-signature-services.why: Reverted from 24.3.3.9 (psapp-saas#14). Newer tags either needed spring.mail.* to start (24.3.3.9; application.yml now sets it, but that alone doesn't make it seal), can't reach the stamping company (24.3.0.35, 24.3.0.37-24.3.0.40: "Company 'null' not found"), or rewrite the B_BES LocalDemo profile to PAdES-BASELINE-LT after the first seal so every later seal needs a TSA (24.3.0.43-24.3.3.9). 24.3.0.29 is the build psapp's dev stack runs with an otherwise-identical config. Before moving this pin, run installation-scripts/dmss-seal-smoke.sh against the candidate (documentation/39-release-procedure.md). Moving to 24.3.3.x or later also needs an upgrade.sh migration that adds application.yml's spring.mail / management.health.mail block to existing deployments. Also diff the candidate jar's own BOOT-INF/classes/application.yml against dmss-container-and-signature-services/application.yml: SPRING_CONFIG_LOCATION=/confs/ replaces the in-jar file, so every default it sets is dropped (in 24.3.3.9 that includes spring.mail.host, management.tracing.enabled and emailSigning.*), and the image may rely on one.

nginx.why: Pinned to nginx's 'stable' release line, not 'latest'/'mainline'. 'latest' resolved to 1.31.6 (mainline) at the time this was pinned - mainline gets new features and is not the line nginx recommends for production. Re-pin to a newer 1.30.x stable release, not to mainline, when updating.
